description: What input_map's keys accept beyond its actions' signatures.

input_key.description: A key of an input map dict, as passed to input_map_channel_register or input_map_single or returned by an input_map override: an input name, or names for a combo ('pop cluck'), then ':' modifiers ('pop:power>10:th_100').

modifier.description: A ':' segment on an input map key.

oneOf.title: throttle
oneOf.description: Fires at once, then ignores this input until this long has passed.

oneOf.title: debounce
oneOf.description: Waits this long before firing, starting over each time the input comes again. On a stop: a start inside the wait cancels the stop and is skipped too, so a brief gap doesn't count as letting go. On a start whose stop is debounced too: a stop inside the wait cancels both.
Fires at once even when a combo starting with this input could still follow, and still tracks the combo. Without it the first input of a combo waits out the combo window.

oneOf.title: after
oneOf.description: Fires this long after the input, as well as the plain binding, unless a combo uses the input first. The input coming again starts the wait over. One per input, and it takes no conditions, throttle or debounce: those are dropped.

oneOf.title: init
oneOf.description: Used in place of the plain binding for this long after the mode is entered. Pair it with a plain key; not with else.

oneOf.title: condition
oneOf.description: Fires only while the variable compares true against the number. Several on one key all have to hold.
Fires when none of this input's conditions hold. Makes them edge-triggered: once per change of which one holds, not on every event.

condition_variable.description: What a condition compares. Each is only there when the input comes in through an action that hands it over.

oneOf.description: How loud the parrot noise is.
A value the input carries, as how far a face expression is made.
How long since the input started, in ms. Only on its '_stop' or '_up' key.

operator.description: How a condition compares its variable with its number.
